author.name: Fidel Castro
author.heading: About Fidel Castro
author.bio: Fidel Castro led the movement that overthrew Fulgencio Batista in 1959 and subsequently governed Cuba as prime minister and president. His revolutionary speeches became widely circulated political documents, while Cuba consolidated a one-party communist state.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: Speaking after the revolutionary victory, Castro warns the celebrating crowd that the remaining tasks may be harder than the military struggle. He connects truth-telling with acknowledging setbacks rather than deceiving supporters, making the sentence a warning against exaggerated expectations.
